headline: Last session: Sensex jumped 897 points while Nifty reached 25,800; market remains closed today for weekend.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: In the last trading session on November 20, Sensex surged 897 points to reach 25,800.
The Indian Rupee recorded its largest single-day gain in a month during the previous session.
CBIC proposed draft GST changes aimed at shielding genuine buyers from input tax credit (ITC) loss.
RBI Governor urged commercial banks to increase lending to small businesses to boost economic growth.
whatHappening: IndusInd Bank terminated the services of Sumant Kathpalia and invoked clawback provisions.
The Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday 22 November 2026, for the weekend.
Earlier sessions in November saw market rallies driven by financials and foreign capital inflows.
Milk supplier Gokul raised prices for buffalo milk by ₹6 and cow milk by ₹4 per liter.
summary:
The stock market is closed today, Sunday 22 November 2026, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
In the last trading session on November 20, the Sensex rallied 897 points to close at 25,800 alongside strong rupee gains.
Key corporate updates include IndusInd Bank terminating the services of Sumant Kathpalia.
